## 2026-07-29 — Desktop / Wayland / GPU-CUDA research (docs/desktop-gpu-research.md)

Research-only (read+fetch+write, NO builds, NO git commit). Assessed graphical-
desktop, Wayland, and GPU/CUDA support across the illumos family and produced a
grounded phased plan toward a modern desktop (ideally COSMIC). Read
package-universe.md (desktop) + roadmap.md (Phase 3) + phase3-breadth/tasks.md
(T3.7) first. Deliverable: docs/desktop-gpu-research.md. Honesty-over-optimism.

FINDINGS (all cited from primary sources in the deliverable):
  * Best desktop distro: OpenIndiana Hipster = MATE (GTK3), since 2016.10 (was
    GNOME 2); `pkg install mate_install` + lightdm. Tribblix 2nd = Xfce + twm +
    wmaker (X11 multi-WM). OmniOS/SmartOS = server-only, no desktop. Oracle
    Solaris 11 GNOME2 = closed fork, unusable as source.
  * Wayland on illumos = EXPERIMENTAL/partial. Only piece present:
    `oi-userland/components/wayland/freeway` — a portable libwayland protocol
    library (wayland-scanner + client/server core), actively getting a "solaris
    backend" (git.sr.ht/~shrub900/freeway). NO compositor, NO libinput/evdev,
    NO seatd/logind, NO wlroots/weston/sway anywhere in the 32,592-path
    oi-userland tree. Blocker = input stack (libinput/evdev unported) + no
    Wayland render backend (mesa built X11-only).
  * GPU/CUDA verdict: CUDA IMPOSSIBLE (no NVIDIA kernel driver on modern
    illumos; Solaris CUDA dropped ~2013). illumos DRM/KMS = only OLD i915 (Intel)
    + radeon (AMD) via illumos/gfx-drm (pre-2013 libdrm snapshot); no
    amdgpu/nouveau/nvidia/vmwgfx/virtio-gpu. mesa 21.3.9 built
    `-Dgallium-drivers='swrast,i915,r600' -Dvulkan-drivers='' -Dplatforms='x11'
    -Dllvm=false` (SMOKING GUN: softpipe SW only — NOT even llvmpipe; NO Vulkan;
    NO Wayland platform). OpenGL = HW only on old Intel/AMD, else softpipe SW.
    LLM = CPU-inference-only for the foreseeable future.
  * COSMIC verdict: ASPIRATIONAL, blocked BELOW the compositor. cosmic-comp =
    smithay (udev/DRM/libinput backend) + wgpu(GL/Vulkan). smithay's
    drm/libinput/udev are OPTIONAL cargo features and it has winit + x11
    backends → the ONLY plausible path is COSMIC nested-in-Xorg via smithay
    winit + wgpu-GL on softpipe (slow, needs llvmpipe first + backend
    confirmation). A real Wayland-session COSMIC needs libinput + udev/devd shim
    + seatd + Wayland-mesa — all unported (multi-quarter, kernel-adjacent).
    Minimal substrate ladder documented.

DEPENDENCY LADDER (R0..R11) + PHASED TODO for T3.7:
  * P-D1 X11 + SW-mesa(softpipe) + MATE/Xfce  — feasible-now, FIRST real goal.
    (P-D1b: LLVM→llvmpipe rebuild, hard, prereq for wgpu/COSMIC.)
  * P-D2 Wayland substrate: freeway(easy) + libinput/evdev + seatd/udev-shim —
    hard→blocked, kernel-adjacent multi-quarter port.
  * P-D3 SW Wayland compositor (weston-headless / wlroots-shm) — hard, proof-of-life.
  * P-D4 COSMIC nested-in-X11 via smithay-winit+wgpu-GL — aspirational; real
    session (R11) BLOCKED on P-D2/P-D3.
  * P-D5 GPU/CUDA/Vulkan — separate long-horizon, likely-INFEASIBLE (do-not-promise).

RECURRING ROOT-CAUSE FIXES (this wave's lessons):
  - Makefiles hardcoding `cc`: pass CC=/usr/gcc/14/bin/gcc (pciutils/dmidecode);
    memtester reads first line of conf-cc/conf-ld files -> rewrote those to gcc.
  - illumos vs ncurses curses: cached ncurses ships only libncursesw (wide), and
    illumos /usr/include/curses.h maps addch->w32addch/acs32map. Curses TUIs
    (bvi/hexcurse/hexedit) link cleanly against illumos system -lcurses, NOT the
    cached ncursesw. hexcurse/hexedit also need -fcommon (GCC14 -fno-common vs
    tentative-defs-in-headers) + -Dtrue/-Dfalse (ncurses bool w/o C99 tokens) +
    -DKEY_RESIZE=0632 (missing from illumos curses.h).

   -Wimplicit-function-declaration / -Wimplicit-int /
   -Wincompatible-pointer-types to HARD ERRORS by default. Portable code hits
   them on Solaris paths a pre-14 (or real sparcv9-solaris) gcc accepted -- e.g.
   gnulib sigsegv.c does signal(signo, SIG_DFL) where Solaris SIG_DFL is
   void(*)(void) but signal() wants void(*)(int) -> hard error (blocked
   grep-3.12; would also block gawk). Demoted all three back to warnings in the
   cc common flags. Same class as the existing __sparcv9/__sun macro gaps
   (compiler-era mismatch, not a codegen bug). This unblocked grep AND gawk.

## 2026-07-29 — DIRECTIVE: NetBSD drivers first for Wayland/CUDA substrate (P-D2)

Maintainer: for missing drivers (Wayland substrate + GPU), START WITH NetBSD drivers.
Rationale: NetBSD = most portable BSD, BSD-2 (CDLL-compatible w/ attribution), and its
sys/external/bsd/drm2/ is a full DRM/KMS port WITH a linux-KPI BSD compat shim — the
exact model for bringing Linux-derived DRM to a non-Linux (illumos) kernel. Its input
(wscons/hid/evdev-analog) is cleaner to adapt than Linux evdev.
P-D2 blockers (from desktop-gpu-research.md): (1) input libinput/evdev, (2) render
GBM/EGL/DRM-KMS backend, (3) seat seatd/logind. NetBSD supplies drm2 (DRM/KMS+shim),
wscons/hid (input). NOTE on CUDA: NetBSD does NOT solve CUDA (no BSD has an NVIDIA CUDA
kernel driver) — but its drm2 amdgpu/nouveau/i915 ports are the gateway to HARDWARE GL/
compute if pursued; CUDA itself stays infeasible, LLM=CPU. Launching NetBSD-driver
harvest/mapping agent for the Wayland substrate.

## 2026-07-29 — DIRECTIVE: full GPU/Vulkan/CUDA/ROCm license-compatible source survey (Linux-parity goal)

Maintainer: find ALL license-compatible source (BSD/Mesa/macOS-OSS/vendor) for OpenGL/
Vulkan/NVIDIA/CUDA kernel+userspace drivers; goal = Linux parity for graphics + GPU
LLM hosting (1+ GPUs). Queued deep survey agent 58c7bb9d -> docs/gpu-parity-survey.md.
Reachable candidate sources confirmed: Mesa (MIT — RADV/NVK/ANV/lavapipe), FreeBSD
drm-kmod (BSD, LinuxKPI shim — most current BSD amdgpu), NetBSD drm2, NVIDIA open-gpu-
kernel-modules (MIT/GPL dual, Turing+), AMD ROCK (GPL), apple-oss.
PRELIMINARY HONEST READ (pending survey evidence):
- SW parity = REAL + near-term: Mesa lavapipe (MIT SW Vulkan, ZERO kernel work) +
  llvmpipe (SW GL) = genuine Vulkan/GL API parity, slow. llama.cpp has a VULKAN backend
  -> a SW-Vulkan-compute LLM path that SIDESTEPS CUDA/ROCm entirely.
- HW graphics = HARD (1-2yr): the license-clean route is a LOADABLE CDDL-kernel module +
  LinuxKPI shim (as FreeBSD drm-kmod / NetBSD drm2 do) wrapping GPL amdgpu/i915 — "mere
  aggregation" avoids the GPL-static-link-into-CDDL conflict. This is the gateway.
- CUDA / HW-NVIDIA parity / Metal = near-impossible: CUDA userland is closed Linux/Win-
  only; NVIDIA-open-kernel-module (MIT/GPL) is the ONLY open NVIDIA path but Linux-bound;
  Metal is closed. LLM-on-NVIDIA-GPU at Linux parity is a long-shot.
- KERNEL-LICENSE CRUX: GPL DRM in a CDDL kernel = conflict UNLESS loadable-module+shim
  (the BSD model). That verdict gates all HW GPU work.
- REALISTIC parity: SW Vulkan/GL + CPU/Vulkan-compute LLM = YES (quarters); HW amdgpu via
  LinuxKPI = maybe (1-2yr); CUDA/HW-NVIDIA = no. Survey will detail + cite.

NEW cross-gaps ROOT-CAUSED + FIXED (in sparc-lib-xbuild.sh / sparcv9-solaris-cc,
all tagged with NOTE comments):
  1. NOTE(cppflags-env-not-override) [driver]: passing CPPFLAGS=... as a `make VAR=`
     command-line arg OVERRODE hand-written Makefiles' own `CPPFLAGS = -I../ncurses ...`
     (make gives command-line vars top precedence) -> wiped ncurses' internal -I paths
     -> "fatal error: curses.priv.h". FIX: export CPPFLAGS/LDFLAGS via ENVIRONMENT at
     make time (env seeds default, does NOT override in-Makefile assignment); autoconf
     Makefiles already baked our flags at configure time.
  2. NOTE(solaris-R-runpath) [cc]: Solaris Makefiles pass `-R <dir>`/`-R<dir>` (Sun ld
     runpath); GNU gcc rejects -R. FIX: translate to -Wl,-rpath,<dir> in the wrapper
     (same class as -mimpure-text/-pthread). Unblocked ncurses test/progs + install.
  3. NOTE(host-strip-cross) [driver]: `make install` (install -s) ran HOST binutils
     strip on sparcv9 bins -> "strip: Unable to recognise the format" (ncurses tic).
     FIX: install with STRIP=: INSTALL_STRIP_PROGRAM=: (no-op); unstripped target bins
     are correct.
  4. NOTE(host-probe-help-trim) [driver]: the autoconf-vs-CHOST probe grepped
     `./configure --help` for '--host', but less-668 (real autoconf 2.72) TRIMS the
     "System types" help section -> false negative -> CHOST branch dropped
     --host/--build -> configure tried to RUN the sparcv9 a.out ("cannot run C compiled
     programs"). FIX: probe the configure SCRIPT for `host_alias` (reliable regardless
     of help trimming).
  5. NOTE(ncursesw-incdir) [driver]: ncurses widec installs headers to include/ncursesw/,
     not include/; tmux/vim/nano #include <ncurses.h>/<curses.h> on the plain path and
     failed "curses not found". FIX: SPARC_DEPS loop also adds include/ncursesw when
     present.
  6. ncurses-compat shim (see above): widec-only lib set breaks consumers linking
     -lncurses/-ltinfo (tmux's b64_ntop configure link-test failed on missing -lncurses,
     so tmux fell back to its own b64 compat -> conflicted with Solaris <resolv.h>
     b64_ntop decl). Shim of libncurses/curses/tinfo{,w}.so -> libncursesw.so resolved it.
  7. NOTE(stub-configure-subdir) [driver]: vim ships a 6-line ./configure STUB (cd src &&
     exec ./configure) with no host_alias -> CHOST branch -> "cannot run C compiled
     programs". FIX: probe src/configure + src/auto/configure for host_alias too. vim
     also needs vim_cv_* cross-cache answers (built via src/configure by hand this run).
  8. NOTE(gcc14-int-conversion) [cc]: GCC14 promoted -Wint-conversion to a hard error;
     Solaris libc funcs present-but-undeclared (git's memmem) default to implicit int
     return -> pointer-assignment error. FIX: demote to warning (same class as the
     existing gcc14-werror NOTE). For git specifically, the CORRECT fix was
     ac_cv_func_memmem=no so git uses its bundled 64-bit-safe compat memmem (a
     silenced implicit-int memmem would truncate the pointer to 32 bits and crash).

# 2026-07-29 — P-D2 substrate: NetBSD-sourced driver-substrate adoption plan (research/map, NO builds)

**Mapped every P-D2 Wayland blocker (input + DRM/KMS render + seat) onto real
NetBSD source and produced a concrete NetBSD-sourced adoption plan with honest
quarters-scale effort.** Read `docs/desktop-gpu-research.md` (the P-D2 blocker
analysis) + `docs/prior-art-n-hys-riscv.md` (CDDL n-hys attribution model)
FIRST. Cloned NetBSD/src shallow-sparse (`--depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse`,
`sparse-checkout set sys/external/bsd/drm2 sys/dev/wscons sys/dev/hid
sys/external/bsd/common share/man/man4`, HEAD 2026-07-29), read the structure +
key shim files, then DISCARDED the 286M checkout — kept only a 16K manifest.
Full analysis: `docs/netbsd-driver-substrate.md`; manifest
`artifacts/netbsd-substrate/`.

- **WHY NetBSD confirmed:** `sys/external/bsd/drm2/README` line 1 = "Linux
  DRM/KMS graphics driver subsystem" — Linux-derived `dist/` (~501,700 LOC)
  wrapped in a **BSD-2-clause linux-KPI shim** that IS the reusable pattern for
  Linux-DRM-on-a-non-Linux-kernel (our exact illumos problem; illumos already
  did the shape twice — ancient gfx-drm + the lx brand). Shim = two layers:
  `drm2/linux/` (31 `linux_*.c`, 11,265 LOC + 178 emulated `include/linux/*.h`)
  and shared `common/linux/` (`linux_work.c` workqueue, rcu/srcu/tasklet — 4
  `.c`, 3,044 LOC + 28 headers), plus NetBSD glue `drm2/drm/` (20 `.c`, 4,417
  LOC). **Key number: 500k LOC Linux driver rides on ~20k LOC of NetBSD-authored
  shim/glue — that 20k is the real illumos porting surface.**
- **Attribution:** 30/31 shim `.c` = 2-clause BSD, NetBSD Foundation (BSD-2 =
  CDDL-compatible, attribution-only — same posture as CDDL n-hys). Keep headers
  + `$NetBSD$` RCS ids verbatim, track adopted paths in `docs/registry/`.
- **DRM/KMS verdict:** ADOPT drm2 as the model, ADAPT the ~20k shim to illumos
  (`linux_pci.c`->ddi, `linux_work.c`->taskq, `linux_kmap.c`->seg/hat,
  `drm_cdevsw.c`->cb_ops); do NOT rewrite the Linux core. i915 first. ~3-4q to
  first modeset. HW drivers in-tree: i915 (241k LOC), amdgpu(164)+amdkfd(33),
  nouveau(739), radeon, virtio-gpu, ast, qxl, vmwgfx. Base ~Linux 5.6-era
  (i915 GEN11/GEN12).
- **Input verdict (THE WALL, blunt):** libinput-over-NetBSD-evdev is **NOT
  feasible — NetBSD has NO evdev at all** (full-tree search: 0 hits; it uses
  `wsevent`/`struct wscons_event`, not Linux evdev). Real path = illumos-native
  evdev char-device + input_event translation over existing illumos HID/kbd/
  mouse + a libudev-enumeration shim, THEN a libinput port. NetBSD = reference
  only (`hid.c` parser, wskbd/wsmouse semantics, `linux_keymap.c` keymap). ~3-5+q,
  biggest schedule risk. De-risk with X-nested demo first.
- **GBM/EGL verdict:** ADOPT the ABI, rebuild Mesa. `drm.4` confirms drm2 exposes
  `/dev/dri/{card,render}*` with the standard Linux DRM ioctl UAPI, so Mesa
  GBM/EGL run UNMODIFIED — once the drm shim delivers `/dev/dri/*`, GBM/EGL are a
  `-Dplatforms='x11,wayland'` + illumos-fixups REBUILD (~1q), not a port. Plus
  optional llvmpipe (LLVM-on-illumos, ~1-2q). This ABI-preservation is the whole
  payoff of choosing NetBSD.
- **Seat verdict:** ADAPT a thin `libseat` builtin backend; NO seatd/logind.
  NetBSD has no seat daemon (X holds DRM master via `drm_master_open` on card
  open); illumos does the same. Not a blocker (~0.25-0.5q).
- **Ordered plan + first milestone:** S0 spike gfx-drm node -> **S1 DRM shim +
  i915 => MILESTONE A: first DRM/KMS MODESET on illumos on OLD INTEL** (keystone,
  ~3-4q) -> S2 GBM/EGL rebuild -> S3 libinput-over-evdev (the wall) -> S4 seat ->
  S5 SW-SHM compositor (weston-terminal proof-of-life) -> S6 DRM/GBM present =>
  MILESTONE E: standalone Wayland session on old Intel. Honest horizon to E:
  **~2.5-3.5 years single-engineer**, dominated by DRM shim + input.
- **CUDA:** CONFIRMED BLOCKED PERMANENTLY. drm2 has amdgpu+amdkfd+nouveau+
  virtio-gpu, so HW OpenGL / maybe Vulkan (Mesa rebuild, same UAPI) are
  downstream-reachable — but nouveau != CUDA and NO BSD has an NVIDIA CUDA kernel
  driver. NetBSD moves the display/GL needle, NOT the CUDA needle. **LLM stays
  CPU-inference-only** (llama.cpp/bitnet.cpp + OpenBLAS), per T3.3/roadmap.

## GPU/AI-LLM Linux-parity survey (research, no builds) — 2026-07-29

Read `docs/desktop-gpu-research.md` + `docs/netbsd-driver-substrate.md` first,
then surveyed all license-compatible GPU-graphics + AI/LLM-compute source by
fetching real repos/licenses (piped, nothing hoarded). Wrote
`docs/gpu-parity-survey.md`.

Key findings (all licenses read verbatim from COPYING/LICENSE/headers/meson):
- **Kernel DRM donors:** NetBSD drm2 (BSD-2 shim / Linux ~5.6). **FreeBSD
  drm-kmod = the most current BSD DRM: BSD-2 LinuxKPI, tracks Linux 6.12 (tag
  drm_v6.12.85), amdgpu gfx11/RDNA3 present (gfx_v11_0.c, gmc_v11_0.c, soc21.c,
  nv.c).** NVIDIA open-gpu-kernel-modules = dual MIT/GPLv2 but 89 Linux-specific
  kernel-open/nvidia/nv-*.c glue files + GSP firmware + proprietary userland =
  near-impossible to port. AMD ROCK/amdgpu = GPL-2.0. Intel i915/xe = GPL-2.0.
- **Userspace (the good news):** Mesa = MIT and **already recognizes `sunos`**
  (meson.build: `sunos` in system_has_kms_drm + explicit `elif system=='sunos'`
  branch). lavapipe/llvmpipe/RADV/ANV/NVK/zink all MIT.
- **Compute:** llama.cpp = MIT with CPU/BLAS/Vulkan/SYCL/CUDA/HIP/Metal backends
  (`-DGGML_VULKAN=ON` is the whole knob). HIP=MIT, ROCr=NCSA, rocBLAS=MIT/Apache,
  oneAPI=Apache, OpenBLAS=BSD-3. CUDA/Metal = proprietary closed.
- **Kernel-license crux (CDDL vs GPL):** loadable-shim path = **VIABLE**. GPL DRM
  static-linked into CDDL kernel is a conflict, but the FreeBSD-drm-kmod /
  NetBSD-drm2 model (BSD-licensed LinuxKPI shim + Linux driver imported verbatim,
  combined only at load as a loadable CDDL-kernel module) avoids it. illumos
  already does the analogous thing (gfx-drm, lx brand). Licensing is the SMALLER
  problem; the ~20k-LOC shim engineering is the real cost.
- **Apple/Metal = DEAD END:** apple-oss-distributions ships only legacy
  IOGraphics / AppleADBDisplay / IOKitUser — no Metal, no GPU accel, no compute,
  no IOAccelerator family.

Two parity ladders written:
- **GRAPHICS:** SW-first (lavapipe SW Vulkan + llvmpipe SW GL = REAL Vulkan/GL
  parity in quarters, ZERO kernel work, gated on LLVM-on-illumos + Mesa rebuild)
  → HW (LinuxKPI DRM shim → RADV/ANV, 1–2yr) → NVIDIA HW (near-impossible).
- **AI/LLM:** CPU llama.cpp now → llama.cpp Vulkan backend on lavapipe (GPU-less
  validation path, quarters) → Vulkan-compute on RADV (the realistic, CUDA-free,
  ROCm-free HW-GPU-LLM path, rides on the 1–2yr DRM wall) → CUDA/ROCm/SYCL
  blocked.

Blunt verdict: SW Vulkan/GL parity + CPU/Vulkan-compute LLM = YES (quarters);
HW amdgpu/i915 via LinuxKPI port = HARD (1–2yr); CUDA + NVIDIA-HW-at-parity +
ROCm stack + Metal = NEAR-IMPOSSIBLE (do NOT promise). Recommended first steps:
(1) LLVM-on-illumos + Mesa rebuild → lavapipe+llvmpipe; (2) llama.cpp GGML_VULKAN
on lavapipe; (3) scope a FreeBSD-drm-kmod-style LinuxKPI shim (S0 spike first).

### Mesa-SW (Tier C, P-D1b stretch): ATTEMPTED, DEFERRED (defer-ok per task).
  mesa 21.3.9 (swrast/softpipe, x11 platform, no llvm/vulkan — OI's flags).
  meson config SUCCEEDED; compile hit genuine illumos gaps needing a source
  patch series (pthread_getcpuclockid absent; struct dirent has no d_type/DT_REG
  — mesa util assumes Linux/BSD). GTK3 (the priority) landed WITHOUT mesa —
  libepoxy dlopens GL at desktop RUN time, so mesa is a runtime need, not a
  build-the-toolkit need. Upgrade path: port OI's oi-userland x11/mesa patches.
  (Correct URL: archive.mesa3d.org/older-versions/21.x/mesa-21.3.9.tar.xz.)

### NEW build infrastructure this wave (benefits all future meson waves):
  1. **scripts/oi-meson-bootstrap.sh** — the fleet had NO meson/ninja/pip. Stages
     ninja 1.12.1 (C++ `configure.py --bootstrap` compile) + meson 1.4.2
     (pure-python, run-from-release-tree — no pip needed) into
     /opt/solnix-buildtools/bin. Python 3.9.25 is fine for meson 1.4.x.
  2. **scripts/oi-cmeson.sh** — meson sibling of oi-clib.sh: dep include/lib/
     rpath/pkgconfig wiring, meson native-file (gcc14+pkg-config), split debug,
     relocatable .pc, .la strip, RUNPATH relocation, nix-store add (out+debug).

### illumos root-cause fixes this wave (reusable knobs, NOTE: not ponytail):
  1. **-D_POSIX_PTHREAD_SEMANTICS** — illumos gates the POSIX.1c 5-arg int
     getpwnam_r/getpwuid_r behind this macro; without it __EXTENSIONS__ gives
     the 4-arg draft form (glib gutils.c/glib-unix.c "too many arguments").
     THE canonical illumos fix; applied to every glib-consuming build.
  2. **-Wno-error=incompatible-pointer-types** — illumos iconv(3) takes
     `const char **inbuf`; glib passes `char **`; gcc14 makes it a hard error.
  3. **-lsocket -lnsl** — illumos splits BSD sockets into libsocket/libnsl
     (gio networking, dbus, at-spi2).
  4. **-Dxattr=false** (glib) — illumos has no getxattr/attr/xattr.h.
  5. **oi-cmeson .pc shim** — cached deps built before oi-clib's .pc relocation
     fix (freetype2.pc, pcre2 .pc) bake a DEAD /var/tmp/clib.*/out prefix in
     exec_prefix/libdir/includedir/Libs — fatal under -Werror=missing-include-
     dirs (harfbuzz: ft2build.h not found; glib: dead pcre2 -I). Fix: copy each
     dep's .pc into a writable shim dir with EVERY dead build-temp absolute path
     rewritten to the dep's real store path, and search the shim first. Fixes
     freetype/pcre2 for every future consumer without touching the read-only store.
  6. **transitive-dep pass-through** — oi-cmeson isn't closure-transitive; glib2
     pulls libffi.so.8/libz.so via NEEDED, so consumers must be handed
     glib2's deps (libffi/pcre2/zlib) explicitly for the link stage.
  7. **libxml2 .pc shadowing** — passing the cached libxml2 as a dep (first in
     PKG_CONFIG_PATH) shadows OI's system libxml2 that drags icu-uc (unmet).

### Meson option-name quirks discovered (per-package, documented in failures.txt):
  glib2: selinux/libmount/nls=feature, man/dtrace/systemtap/tests/xattr=boolean.
  at-spi2-core: no `tests` (uses docs/introspection/x11/use_systemd).
  pango: gtk_doc/install-tests/xft (not docs/tests); xft disabled (libXft
    deferred in P-D1 — pango renders via cairo+freetype+fontconfig).
  adwaita-icon-theme 44.0: AUTOTOOLS not meson (built via oi-clib configure).

## 2026-07-29 — x86_64 install-media track: bootable ISO + USB to the solnix installer (T2.7/T2.13)

Stood up the solnix install-media track (maintainer priority). Built the illumos
media path on the ouch fleet (builder, <builder-ip>) and boot-tested locally
in qemu (every run timeout-wrapped + detached — no wedge). New scripts:
- `scripts/oi-make-livecd.sh` (fleet: slice a minimal live root -> gzipped UFS
  boot_archive -> ISO staging tree),
- `scripts/make-iso-usb.sh` (local: xorriso hybrid ISO + dd-able USB img),
- `scripts/qemu-boottest.sh` (timeout-wrapped/detached qemu BIOS+UEFI tester).
Reused the `oi-make-be.sh` gotchas (dir perms, /dev symlinks, driver-config
files incl. name_to_sysnum, ttya console) + the `solnix-install` toplevel->BE path.

### RESULTS

**x86_64 bootable ISO built + boots: YES.** `artifacts/install-media/solnix-x86_64.iso`
(108 MB hybrid). Boots the illumos loader (BIOS El Torito `cdboot` + UEFI ESP
`BOOTX64.EFI`=`loader64.efi`) -> `unix` -> mounts the gzipped-UFS boot_archive as
`/ramdisk:a` rootfs -> the solnix live-installer banner. qemu log quote
(boot-logs/iso-final-bios.log): `root on /ramdisk:a fstype ufs` then
`#   The Solnix Operating System — Live Installer   #`. UEFI identical
(iso-final-uefi.log, via OVMF: `illumos/amd64 EFI loader ... \EFI\BOOT\BOOTX64.EFI`).

**USB image boots: YES (UEFI).** Same isohybrid image (`solnix-x86_64-usb.img`),
GPT partition 2 = EF00 EFI System Partition. OVMF loads the loader from NVMe/ESP
-> kernel -> `root on /ramdisk:a` (boot-logs/usb-uefi.log). BIOS-USB pending the
isohybrid MBR bootcode (`-append_partition` dropped it) — UEFI-USB is the modern
path and works.

**solnix-install installs + installed disk boots: NO — two precise gaps found
(documented, not hidden):**
  1. **No solnix toplevel baked into the media.** `solnix-install` installs a
     toplevel closure (`/run-current-system` or arg); the minimal live ramdisk
     has none in `/nix/store`, so it has nothing to install (fails
     "no toplevel given"). FIX: bake a `system.build.toplevel` closure into the
     ramdisk (or fetch from solnix.io at install time).
  2. **Live ramdisk root is read-only** (kernel mounts the UFS boot_archive RO).
     The bare-shell PID-1 init cannot mount mnttab/dev/tmpfs — the mntfs/dev
     kernel fs modules don't auto-load ("mnttab is not this fstype") and
     `mount(1M)` opens /etc/mnttab O_RDWR (fails on RO root), so `devfsadm`
     can't create `/dev/dsk` links and the installer can't see target disks
     (verified across 6 install-test iterations, boot-logs/install-test-attempt.log:
     the SATA scratch disk attaches cleanly but has no `/dev/rdsk/cNtNdN` node).
     Root cause: the bare-shell live-init skips the standard illumos early-boot
     SMF sequence (`svc.startd` -> `fs-root`/`fs-usr`/`manifest-import`) that
     sets up the writable overlays + auto-loads the fs modules. This is the
     OI/OmniOS live-media model. The boot chain + banner are proven; only this
     writable-root plumbing remains for a working install.

Progressed through the full illumos boot bring-up (each fixed in the scripts):
loader.conf quote-escaping (broke rootfs -> "No rootfs module"); boot_archive
oversize -> loader OOM (fixed: minimal ldd-closure slice ~130MB du, gzipped
93MB, `hash_load=NO`); `/etc/name_to_sysnum` missing -> kernel panic (added);
qemu default CPU lacks SEP -> `ld.so.1 CA_SUNW_HW_1 unsupported` (fixed: qemu
`-cpu host` via KVM); `/sbin/sh`->32-bit i86 ksh93 dangling (repoint to 64-bit
ksh93); illumos `init`->svc.startd SIGKILL loop without SMF (replaced /sbin/init
with a looping PID-1 shell wrapper). illumos NVMe driver panics on qemu NVMe
emulation -> scratch target on AHCI/SATA instead.

### DELIVERABLES

- `artifacts/install-media/solnix-x86_64.iso` (BIOS+UEFI, boots to installer)
- `artifacts/install-media/solnix-x86_64-usb.img` (UEFI-dd-able)
- `artifacts/install-media/README.md` (sha256 + how-to-install; for the site
  team per T2.13 "drop .iso in ../solnix.io/" — NOT yet dropped, gaps above)
- `artifacts/install-media/MEDIA-PLAN.md` (all-4-platform boot chain + media:
  x86_64 loader BIOS/UEFI hybrid ISO+USB [buildable NOW]; aarch64 U-Boot/EFI
  EBBR -> BOOTAA64.EFI UEFI ISO+USB/SD [kernel A8; needs aarch64 loader+host];
  sparcv9 OBP `boot cdrom` Sun-VTOC ISO [sun4u hardware only, no QEMU OBP];
  riscv64 U-Boot `booti` dd-able SD/USB [kernel bring-up in progress, layout
  matches solnix-k1.img])
- `artifacts/install-media/boot-logs/` (4 qemu logs: final BIOS/UEFI ISO,
  UEFI USB, install-attempt)

### NEXT STEP to a publishable 4-platform media set (release 2026.08)

x86_64 is closest: (a) bake a solnix toplevel closure into the ramdisk, (b) switch
the live-init from bare-shell to `svc.startd` + a seeded minimal SMF repo (as
`oi-make-be.sh` seeds the repository.db) so the standard `fs-root`/`fs-usr`
methods make root writable + auto-load the fs modules + `devfsadm` populates
`/dev/dsk`; then boot ISO -> `solnix-install <disk>` -> reboot into installed
solnix (the T2.13 smoke test) -> drop `.iso`+sha256+README in `../solnix.io/`.
Then aarch64 (build the AArch64 loader, reuse the scripts minus the BIOS leg),
sparcv9 (SPARC bootblk + VTOC ISO on the Ultra 45), riscv64 (finish K1
kernel bring-up, package the solnix-k1.img layout).

### GTK/desktop progress:
  Wave34 completed the GTK2 toolkit (glib2->fontconfig->cairo/harfbuzz->pango->
  atk->gdk-pixbuf->gtk+2.24). Wave35 adds the FIRST desktop-environment layer on
  top: the XFCE 4.12 core (libxfce4util -> xfconf -> libxfce4ui -> garcon) plus
  the GNOME2 foundation (libIDL, libart_lgpl, libgnomecanvas, GConf, gnome-menus,
  gnome-mime-data) and glue (libglade, gtk-engines themes, desktop-file-utils).
  This is a working XFCE-libs + GNOME2-libs substrate — enough for XFCE panel/
  settings/apps and MATE (GTK2 fork of GNOME2) libraries in later waves, once the
  libwnck window-manager library is unblocked (see failures).

### Root-cause driver fixes this wave (benefit ALL future aarch64 waves):
  1. aa35-driver.sh: `gmake SHELL=/usr/bin/bash` + configure `CONFIG_SHELL/SHELL`
     so libtool's `eval "$my_cmd"` doesn't hit Solaris /bin/sh "syntax error '|'".
  2. aa35-driver-ltfix.sh: runs `autoreconf -fi` (GTKDOCIZE=true to skip absent
     gtk-doc) before configure, to regenerate a consistent libtool 2.5.4 for
     2010-era GNOME tarballs whose bundled libtool 2.2.6 emits malformed `eval |`.
  3. ALWAYS invoke via aa34-wrap.sh (PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR/SYSROOT to sysroot) AND a
     FRESH workdir: a stale prior configure tree silently reused host glib 2.86.5
     .pc instead of sysroot 2.88.2 -> false "package not found". (root cause of the
     first xfconf/libxfce4util "not found" failures).
  4. Manual elfdump of installed BINARIES: driver's verify scans only *.so/*.a and
     skips executables (desktop-file-utils is bins-only) — checked its 3 bins by
     hand; all EM_AARCH64 before publish.
  Cross cache vars used to skip run-tests: ac_cv_func_mmap_fixed_mapped=yes (exo,
  libIDL), libIDL_cv_long_long_format=ll (libIDL guint64 printf), CORBA alignment
  vars (ORBit2, though ORBit2 later blocked on its own idl compiler).

### Minimal usable X session — ASSEMBLABLE NOW:
  WM = **xfwm4** (or **twm** fallback) + terminal = **xterm** +
  panel = **xfce4-panel** + session = **xfce4-session**. All published,
  narinfo 200 (xfwm4, xfce4-panel, xfce4-session, xterm, thunar, twm verified).
  Plus file manager (thunar), settings (xfce4-settings/xfsettingsd), and
  app launcher (xfce4-appfinder). This is a complete Xfce 4.18 session — the
  honest "modern-ish desktop" the research doc calls the first real goal (R4).
  RUN-time still needs a packaged Xorg SERVER (client libs all cached) + a
  display manager or startx wiring; the DE payload itself is done.

### illumos root-cause fixes this wave (reusable knobs, NOTE: not ponytail):
  1. **glib-version-macro clamp** — the single most impactful fix. The system
     gdbus-codegen (glib 2.82) REGENERATES xfconf's xfconf-gdbus-bindings.c with
     code gated on `#if GLIB_VERSION_MAX_ALLOWED >= GLIB_VERSION_2_84`, calling
     `g_variant_builder_init_static` (a glib 2.80+ symbol). Our glib is 2.74.7.
     Root cause: **GLIB_VERSION_2_84 is undefined in glib 2.74 headers → the
     `#if` reads `MAX_ALLOWED >= 0` → always true → the static branch compiles →
     implicit-decl hard error**. Fix: pass BOTH
     `-DGLIB_VERSION_MAX_ALLOWED=GLIB_VERSION_2_74` AND
     `-DGLIB_VERSION_2_84=152576` (= G_ENCODE_VERSION(2,84) pre-computed; the
     paren form breaks make/shell quoting). Applied to every Xfce build.
  2. **CAIRO_HAS_GOBJECT_FUNCTIONS=1** — base cairo's cairo-features.h does NOT
     define it (cairo-gobject is a separate package with its own features.h),
     so cairo-gobject.h guards out CAIRO_GOBJECT_TYPE_SURFACE et al when the
     base cairo include wins the search order → undeclared-identifier error.
     Define it explicitly (both cairo builds are 1.18.2, ABI-compatible).
     Unblocked xfce4-session/xfce4-settings/xfce4-appfinder.
  3. **oi-cmeson LDVERSCRIPT_STRIP** — added the CC/CXX shim (mirroring
     oi-clib's) to oi-cmeson.sh: meson defaults shared libs to `-z defs` and
     adds `-Wl,--version-script`; Solaris ld dies "unrecognized option
     '--version-script'". Shim drops it (symbols keep default global scope).
     Durable for any meson lib with a version map. Unblocked libwnck.
  4. **freetype2.pc/fontconfig.la dead-prefix shim** — cached freetype/fontconfig
     were built before oi-clib's .pc-relocation + .la-strip fixes: their
     freetype2.pc bakes `includedir=/var/tmp/clib.freetype.XXXX/out/include`
     (dead) and libfontconfig.la chases a gone libfreetype.la. For consumers,
     stage a WRITABLE copy of freetype+fontconfig with .la deleted and every
     `/var/tmp/clib.*/out` rewritten to the copy dir, and pass those as deps
     (+ `-I<shim>/include/freetype2`). Unblocked libXft and xfce4-settings.
  5. **at-spi2-core FIRST in dep list** — the link resolved the SYSTEM
     /usr/lib/amd64/libatk-bridge-2.0.so.0 (glib 2.82, wants
     g_once_init_leave_pointer our glib 2.74 lacks). Passing our cached
     at-spi2-core FIRST makes its -L/RUNPATH + atk-bridge-2.0.pc shadow the
     system one. Unblocked libxfce4ui's xfce4-about link.
  6. **-Wno-implicit-function-declaration** (xfce4-session) — xfsm-chooser.c
     calls legacy BSD `bzero`; gcc14 makes implicit-decl a hard DEFAULT error
     (not -Werror-gated, so -Wno-error alone doesn't help). bzero resolves from
     libc under -D__EXTENSIONS__; demote the diagnostic to a warning.
  7. **OI pkg build-tools** — installed intltool + libxslt (xsltproc) and
     iceauth via OI's own `pkg install` on the builders. These are BUILD/session
     tools, not runtime deps of our packages, so they never enter the nix
     closure — the correct place for them is the builder OS, not a nix build.

### S3-cache outage workaround (operational, not a package fix):
  Mid-wave, s3.solnix.io (the binary cache) returned 503 for ~10 min while the
  main site stayed 200. Downstream gtk3-linking builds on fresh hosts couldn't
  oi-pull gtk3. Workaround: consolidate the whole gtk3+Xfce chain on ONE builder
  (host builder, which already had gtk3 + all GTK deps local from the prior GTK3
  wave), so every dep was resolved from the LOCAL nix store, no S3 needed.
  Rebuilt xfconf locally there (its original had been GC'd). Host-to-host
  `nix-store --export | ssh ... --import` seeds a peer without the cache when
  needed. Lesson: for a deep dep chain, prefer a single builder with the base
  toolkit resident over fan-out that re-pulls the toolkit per host.

### Xfce version quirks discovered (documented, per-package):
  xfconf: 4.18.3's generated bindings hard-require glib 2.80+ symbols; 4.18.2 is
    the same after regen (fix is the glib-macro clamp, not a version downgrade).
  xfwm4 4.18.0 / xfce4-panel 4.18.6: hard-require libwnck-3.0 (no --without flag).
  xfce4-session 4.18.3: hard-requires iceauth at configure (X11 session ICE auth).
  openbox 3.6.1: DEFERRED — hard-requires pangoxft, and our pango was built
    WITHOUT Xft (pango has no pangoxft.pc). Needs a pango rebuild with Xft
    (libXft now exists) before openbox/pangoxft consumers build. twm covers the
    lightweight-WM slot meanwhile.

### Fetch-verified (narinfo 200): xfwm4, xfce4-panel, xfce4-session, xterm,
  thunar, twm (6 verified, > the ~4 required).

Dep chain (all sparcv9): libxcb/libXau/libXdmcp (wave7) -> libX11 -> libXext/
libXrender -> libXfixes/libXi/libXrandr/libXcursor -> libXtst/libXdamage/libXcomposite;
freetype+expat (prior waves) -> fontconfig -> libXft. X11 proto headers/.pc + xtrans
(header-only, arch-independent build-deps) staged in /var/tmp/sparc-x11-stage.

### GAPS FOUND + FIXED (all root-caused; NOTE-tagged, not "ponytail" shortcuts):

1. **AC_CHECK_FILE aborts under cross** — libX11's configure does
   `AC_CHECK_FILE(/usr/share/man/man7/attributes.7)` (the Solaris attributes(7)
   man page, present on real Solaris) which errors "cannot check for file existence
   when cross compiling". FIX: seed `ac_cv_file__usr_share_man_man7_attributes_7=yes`
   as a trailing configure cache arg. Passed to every X11 lib.

2. **Missing xtrans build-dep** — libX11 needs xtrans (header-only pkg-config
   package) which wave7 never built (only xorgproto/xcb-proto/util-macros). FIX:
   built+installed xtrans-1.5.2 into the shared /var/tmp/sparc-x11-stage prefix
   (arch-independent headers+.pc, no ELF -> not published, correct).

3. **Dep .la libdir='//lib' misleads libtool** — the sparcv9 dep .la files carry
   `libdir='//lib'` (from the driver's --prefix=/ builds), so libX11's libtool link
   chased `//lib/libXau.la` and failed "not a valid libtool archive". FIX: stage the
   sparcv9 X11 .so/.a + .pc into one writable prefix with the .la files DROPPED
   (distro-standard; .so + .pc suffice for linking). Reusable helper
   artifacts/sparc-xbuild/wave8/stage-dep.sh.

4. **read-only staged headers block clobber (the subtle one)** — nix-store dirs
   are mode r-xr-xr-x; a plain `cp -RP` preserves that, so a *newer* header
   (libX11's real Xlibint.h with the BufAlloc macro) SILENTLY failed to overwrite an
   older proto stub already in the stage -> libXrender's Glyph.c died "expected ';'
   before 'elt'" (BufAlloc undefined). FIX: `chmod -R u+w` the stage after every
   copy so the correct header wins. Baked into stage-dep.sh.

5. **nix pkg-config-wrapper ignores PKG_CONFIG_PATH** — running the build inside
   `nix-shell -p ... pkg-config` pulled the nix pkg-config *wrapper*, which forces
   its own hermetic search path and reported "No package 'freetype2' found" even
   with our PKG_CONFIG_PATH set. FIX: use only `nix-shell -p gperf` (fontconfig's
   build-time gperf) so the *system* pkg-config (~/.nix-profile/bin, respects
   PKG_CONFIG_PATH) is kept.

6. **dep .pc prefix=/ -> //include//lib** — freetype/expat .pc files built with
   --prefix=/ resolve to `-I//include -L//lib` (filesystem root). FIX: stage-dep.sh
   rewrites the .pc prefix/libdir/includedir to the writable stage path.

7. **AC_CHECK_FUNC without -lexpat** — fontconfig's
   `AC_CHECK_FUNC(XML_SetDoctypeDeclHandler)` links WITHOUT -lexpat -> undefined
   under cross -> "no", aborting configure "expat is required". Symbol IS in the
   staged libexpat (verified via readelf). FIX: seed
   `ac_cv_func_XML_SetDoctypeDeclHandler=yes`.

8. **fontconfig dgettext macro clashes with Solaris <libintl.h>** — with NLS off,
   fontconfig `#define dgettext(d,s) (s)`; a later include of Solaris <locale.h>
   pulls <libintl.h> whose real `extern char *dgettext(const char*,const char*)`
   prototype gets macro-mangled -> "expected identifier or '(' before 'const'".
   Solaris libc HAS dgettext. FIX: patched src/fcint.h to `#include <libintl.h>` in
   the NLS-off branch and NOT shadow dgettext (macro replaced by the real decl).

### BLOCKED / partial (honest):

- **pixman / cairo / pango** — pixman 0.44 is meson-only (out of scope for the
  autotools driver); pixman 0.42 (last autotools) and cairo/fontconfig release
  tarballs only reachable via gitlab.freedesktop.org git-SNAPSHOTS (no pre-built
  ./configure) — cairographics.org + freedesktop.org release mirrors are UNreachable
  from this box (curl exit 7). fontconfig was salvaged by autoreconf'ing the gitlab
  snapshot (needed gettext/gperf via nix-shell); pixman-meson/cairo/pango deferred
  (not a codegen gap — build-system + download-mirror gaps).
- **libXpm sxpm/cxpm tools** — the library (libXpm.so.4.11.0) built + published
  fine; the sxpm/cxpm *tools* fail (cxpm.po needs msgfmt, exit 127 = not on PATH;
  sxpm transitive-expat exe-link). NLS-tooling gap, not codegen. Lib is the artifact
  (same lib-only install pattern used for fontconfig).
- **glib2 / nginx / redis / git / openssh / etc.** — glib2 is meson (out of scope);
  git/openssh/rsync/gnupg/coreutils/gawk/sed/grep/findutils/diffutils/gzip/tar/
  sqlite/jq/tmux were ALREADY sparcv9-built in prior waves (skipped as dups per the
  grep-before-build directive). This wave deliberately focused on the untapped X11

## aarch64-solaris desktop wave (aa-xbuild36) — X11 session + apps on builder

Host builder (<builder-ip>), cross-gcc aarch64-unknown-solaris2.11, sysroot
/aarch64/gate/arm64-gate/build/sysroot. Job prefix aa36-. Goal: push toward a
usable `startx -> desktop` session on aarch64, matching the x86 P-D1c track.

libX11 + all core Xlibs, startup-notification, dbus, fontconfig, freetype,
harfbuzz, xcb-util, libXaw, libXft) were ALREADY cached from prior waves.

### CORRECTION to the task premise
Sysroot ships **GTK2** (gtk+-2.0.pc), NOT GTK3 — no gtk-3.0 headers, no
libepoxy/graphene. All desktop apps here target the cached GTK2/Xlib stack.
Cached pango-1.42.4 was ALSO built without the Xft backend (no pangoxft.pc),
which blocks openbox and xfwm4 (both hard-require pangoxft directly).

### 27 NET-NEW published (each elfdump -e EM_AARCH64-CONFIRMED before publish, narinfo 200)
Minimal-session core (startx works):
- **xinit-1.4.4**   — provides `startx` / `xinit` (SESSION LAUNCHER)
- **xauth-1.1.3**   — X cookie auth (startx dependency)
- **twm-1.0.12**    — WINDOW MANAGER (lightweight, Xaw/Xmu; openbox/xfwm blocked on pangoxft)

### IS A MINIMAL aarch64 X SESSION ASSEMBLABLE NOW?  YES.
`startx` (xinit) -> `xauth` cookie -> `twm` WM -> `xterm` terminal, with

### Reusable wave36 tooling (artifacts/aa-xbuild36/)
- aa-xbuild36-driver.sh — desktop wrapper over the base aa-xbuild-driver:
  adds PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR/SYSROOT_DIR pointing at the sysroot (base driver only
  set -I/-L, not pkg-config), pre-seeds cross-hostile autoconf cache vars

  refs; ac_cv_func_mmap_fixed_mapped=yes etc. for AC_FUNC_MMAP), deletes stale

- feh-build.sh — feh needs CFLAGS *appended* not overridden (its config.mk uses

# 2026-07-29 — aarch64 w37: cross-build the Xfce DE (15 net-new, 519 -> 534)

**aarch64 now has a complete Xfce desktop.** Cross-compiled + published 15
net-new C libs/tools for aarch64-solaris on builder (<builder-ip>), all
EM_AARCH64-CONFIRMED (elfdump -e before each publish), arch-tagged
SYSTEM=aarch64-solaris, solnix.io-only, NOT git committed. Job prefix aa37-.
Scratch artifacts/aa-xbuild37/ (driver aa37-driver.sh forked from aa-xbuild).
Recipe: autotools/configure cross via /aarch64/gate/arm64-gate/build/cross
gcc + sysroot; PKG_CONFIG pinned to sysroot .pc; each verified build installed
INTO the sysroot so the deps-first chain resolves.

- **Xfce DE = YES.** Core session gate present: libxfce4util/xfconf/libxfce4ui
  (4.12.1, pre-cached) + **exo 0.10.7, xfce4-panel 4.12.2, xfwm4 4.12.5 (WM),
  xfdesktop 4.12.5, xfce4-settings 4.12.4, xfce4-session 4.12.1 (session mgr),
  thunar 1.6.18 (file mgr), libwnck 2.30.7** — the startx/openbox core is now a
  full Xfce DE. Apps: **xfce4-appfinder 4.12.0, ristretto 0.6.3, xarchiver
  0.5.4.14, mousepad 0.4.0, tumbler 0.1.31**. Deps: **libexif 0.6.24,
  gtksourceview 2.10.5**.
- **Xfce 4.12 (GTK2), NOT 4.18 — the sysroot only ships GTK2.** x86_64 P-D1c is
  Xfce 4.18 (GTK3). The aarch64 cross sysroot has glib 2.88 + gtk+ 2.24.33 +
  libxfce4ui-1/garcon-1 (4.12 gen) and **no gtk3, no libepoxy/at-spi, no
  vte-2.91**. Matching x86's Xfce 4.18 would require bringing up the whole GTK3
  stack first (meson, not autotools, not pre-assigned). So aarch64 gets the SAME
  Xfce *desktop composition* at the 4.12/GTK2 generation the toolchain supports.
  NOTE: to reach 4.18 later, cross-build libepoxy -> at-spi2-core/atk -> gtk+3 ->
  vte, then rebuild the Xfce stack at 4.18.
- **xorg-server: already cached (aarch64 xorg-server + xauth 1.1.3 present); the
  session gate did not block on it.** Session mgr (xfce4-session incl.
  startxfce4) built clean once the AC_FUNC_MALLOC cross trap was fed
  (ac_cv_func_malloc_0_nonnull=yes) — that was the `rpl_malloc` undefined-symbol
  link fail.
- **Driver fixes (all in aa37-driver.sh):** (1) PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR/SYSROOT_DIR ->
  sysroot .pc (host pkg-config otherwise reads amd64); (2) "configure must emit a
  Makefile" guard so a failed configure never publishes an empty store path; (3)
  neutralize exo's UNGUARDED strftime cross run-test (strip the `as_fn_error
  ...cannot run test program while cross compiling` -> bare `}`, braces stay
  balanced); (4) strip `-export-symbols-regex` (cross-libtool misdetects
  NM="link -dump -symbols", empty global_symbol_pipe -> broken `| |`); (5) keep
  --sysroot in CC so libtool's shared-lib link finds crti.o; (6) install each
  verified dest INTO the sysroot (prefix /usr so .pc includedir=/usr/include, not
  /include); (7) gzip|tar pipe + `|| true` (illumos tar exits 1 on GitHub pax
  headers) + src-dir detection that skips pax_global_header and prefers a dir
  with configure(.ac/.in); (8) autoreconf/intltoolize bootstrap for github
  tarballs (mkdir m4 first).
- **Blocked (need GTK3/vte, deferred, in artifacts/aa-xbuild37/failures.txt):**

### GAPS ROOT-CAUSED + FIXED (folded into sparc-lib-xbuild.sh where reusable)
- NOTE(pc-prefix-slash): sparcv9 deps built with --prefix=/ ship a .pc with
  prefix=/, so pkg-config emits -I//include/<pkg> (absolute /, not the store
  path) -> "fatal error: pixman.h / ft2build.h: No such file" (harfbuzz, cairo).
  Fix in driver: for each SPARC_DEP, add every include/<subdir>/ that holds .h
  files directly to -I (covers freetype2, pixman-1, future GTK subdirs).
- NOTE(la-libdir-slash): --prefix=/ deps' libtool .la files have libdir='//lib'
  and dependency_libs referencing sibling '//lib/*.la'; a libtool consumer
  (libXt/libXmu/libXaw pulling libSM/libICE) dies "'//lib/libICE.la' is not a
  valid libtool archive". Driver now rewrites .la libdir + //lib/*.la refs in
  WRITABLE dep mirrors; store paths (read-only) are a no-op. In practice we
  DISABLED the .la in the depfix mirrors so libtool falls back to -L/-l (the
  transitive .la cross-referencing between distinct store paths was intractable).
- xtrans/xproto/kbproto + all X protocol .pc: header-only, arch-independent.
  Built a pcshim/ dir (native xorgproto share/pkgconfig .pc copied in + a
  hand-written xtrans.pc + xtrans headers extracted from the tarball) so x.org
  configure's `pkg-config --exists xproto kbproto xtrans` passes.
- AC_CHECK_FILE(/usr/share/man/man7/attributes.7) + AC_FUNC_MALLOC run-tests are
  cross-hostile ("cannot check file existence / run test program while cross
  compiling"). Seeded ac_cv_file__usr_share_man_man7_attributes_7=no and
  xorg_cv_malloc0_returns_null=yes (Solaris malloc(0)==NULL).
- harfbuzz: mis-detected HAVE_XLOCALE_H=1 (Solaris has no <xlocale.h>); seeded
  ac_cv_header_xlocale_h=no.
- libxkbcommon 0.8.4 hardcodes -Werror=array-bounds (false positive on modern
  gcc's ExprDef union alloc pattern); overrode with CFLAGS=-Wno-error=array-bounds
  and needs YACC="bison -y" (no yacc on host).
- -lthread: glib's configure link-probes append `-lpthread -lthread` (old
  Solaris convention), but Hipster sysroot folds libthread into libc and ships
  NO libthread.so -> EVERY glib link probe failed "cannot find -lthread" (which
  mis-set HAVE_PTHREAD_CONDATTR_SETCLOCK=undef -> #error "Cannot support GCond").
  Fix: a GNU-ld linker-script stub thread-stub/lib/libthread.so = `INPUT( -lc )`
  so -lthread resolves to libc. Confirmed the actual symbol links fine.
- glib gettext codegen: gdbus-codegen ran under host python3.13 which dropped
  distutils -> "ModuleNotFoundError: distutils". Put python3.11 (has distutils)
  first in PATH.
- glib -Werror=format-* (nonliteral/overflow) gcc14 promotions: stripped
  -Werror=<word> from the generated Makefiles (careful sed preserving -Wformat=2)
  + CFLAGS=-Wno-error; and rewrote libffi.pc/zlib.pc prefix=/ in writable
  mirrors to kill the -I//include (which glib's -Werror=missing-include-dirs
  turned fatal). glib built after these; installed all 6 libs.
- cairo: fontconfig.so has DT_NEEDED libexpat.so.1, but linking cairo's TEST
  binary tripped unresolved XML_* (GNU ld checks a shared dep's undefined syms).
  libcairo.so.2 itself built clean (seeded cairo_cv_test_undefined_ldflags=
  -Wl,--allow-shlib-undefined) — only the cairo-test-suite link failed, so we
  installed lib+headers+.pc from src/ (make -C src install). Library is complete.

### BLOCKED (real toolchain gap, NOT a shortcut) — artifacts/sparc-xbuild/wave9/failures.txt
- harfbuzz-8.5.0 — C++ library. The freestanding sparc64-none-elf toolchain has
  NO g++/c++ (only cpp + c++filt) and the Hipster sysroot ships NO libstdc++.
  All .cc objects compiled as HOST x86_64 (EM 62) -> ld "Relocations in generic
  ELF (EM: 62)". Blocks ANY C++ lib on this wave. Upgrade path: build/obtain a
  sparcv9-solaris g++ + libstdc++ (C++ EH tables crtbeginT/crtendT, libsupc++),
  then re-run. All wave9 wins above are C, unaffected. (pango/gdk-pixbuf/atk are
  C but sit atop glib+harfbuzz; deferred pending harfbuzz.)
- nginx-1.27.3 — hand-rolled (non-autotools) configure runs on-target
  feature-probe binaries and rejects the CC= wrapper ("C compiler ... is not
  found"); needs --with-cc + a full set of ngx cross feature-cache seeds.
  Deferred (autotools libs had higher yield).

### FAILURES / DEFERRALS — artifacts/aa-xbuild38/failures.txt
- gv first try: needed Xaw3d (built libXaw3d-1.6.6, then gv succeeded — resolved).
- st-0.9.2 (suckless terminal) — openpty() is Linux/BSD; Solaris uses
  /dev/ptmx+grantpt. st's pty layer needs a Solaris port. Deferred; xterm
  (cached) is the session terminal, and st is a nice-to-have. NOT a toolchain gap.
- galculator-2.1.4 — github tarball ships autogen.sh, no pre-built ./configure;
  the autotools driver needs a released tarball (SF URLs 404'd). Low value
  (calculator); deferred rather than wire autoreconf+intltool.

### DRIVER / INFRA NOTES (aarch64-specific, reusable)
- X.Org autotools cross gate: AC_CHECK_FILE([$MANPAGE]) errors "cannot check for
  file existence when cross compiling". Seeded ac_cv_file__usr_share_man_man7_
  attributes_7=no (+ the sgml defs.ent one) so configure skips the probe.
- libtool .la poison: font libs installed into the sysroot with prefix=/ carry
  .la records pointing at //lib/lib*.la (absolute /lib, not the sysroot), which
  made xorg-server's Xvfb link fail ("cannot find //lib/libfontenc.la"). Fix:
  delete *.la from $SYSROOT/usr/lib — libtool then falls back to -l<name>
  resolved via -L$SYSROOT/usr/lib. Standard cross fix; done after every dep
  install into the sysroot.
- cross pkg-config wired in the driver: PKG_CONFIG_PATH/LIBDIR ->
  $SYSROOT/usr/{lib,share}/pkgconfig + PKG_CONFIG_SYSROOT_DIR=$SYSROOT so .pc
  prefix=/ rewrites into the sysroot.
- gcc-14 promotions added this wave: -Wno-error=return-mismatch (gpicview
  main-win.c had a `return;` in a non-void function).
- Freshly-built libs are installed into the sysroot (cp dest/* -> $SYSROOT/usr/)
  so downstream builds (libXfont2->fontenc, xorg-server->Xfont2, dillo->fltk,
  gv->Xaw3d) resolve them; .la files stripped each time.
- fltk-config found via $SYSROOT/usr/bin prepended to PATH (dillo's configure
  probes it). Its -I//include / -L//lib emissions are harmless (nonexistent
  dirs); real libs resolve via the sysroot -L that fltk baked into its flags.

GAPS FOUND + FIXED (root-caused, not worked-around):
- __EXTENSIONS__ missing (cc wrapper): added -D__EXTENSIONS__ to sparcv9-solaris-cc
  common flags + NOTE(extensions-macro). (screen msghdr probe; real Solaris gcc
  default.) NOTE: __EXTENSIONS__ alone does NOT expose msghdr.msg_control on
  Solaris — that field gates on _XPG4_2 specifically (verified via <sys/socket.h>
  line 365 `#if defined(_XPG4_2)`); so screen used a per-build cc shim adding
  -D_XPG4_2 (too namespace-invasive to put in the global wrapper).
- libxslt: pkg-config .pc has prefix=/ (-> -I//include/libxml2) AND libxml2 headers
  live under include/libxml2/libxml/ (driver's nested-include heuristic only adds
  dirs that hold .h directly, misses the libxml/ subdir). Fix: pass explicit
  LIBXML_CFLAGS=-I<store>/include/libxml2 + LIBXML_LIBS as autoconf precious vars.
- libpcap: R_SPARC_GOT13 relocation-truncated-to-fit on the .so link — objects
  built non-PIC (hand-rolled shared rule, no libtool). Fix: CFLAGS='-fPIC -O2' as
  configure precious var. Also needed flex+bison on the build host (nix-shell -p).
- mpc: '//lib/libgmp.la is not a valid libtool archive' — the driver's
  NOTE(la-libdir-slash) .la-rewrite is a no-op on read-only store deps. Fix: made
  WRITABLE mirrors (cp -RL + chmod u+w) of gmp+mpfr, rewrote their .la libdir +
  cross-dep refs (mpfr's libmpfr.la -> $mir/gmp/lib/libgmp.la), passed mirrors as
  SPARC_DEPS + --with-gmp/--with-mpfr. (Exactly the "pass writable mirrors for X
  libtool" path the driver NOTE anticipates.)
- inetutils: undefined shutdown/gai_strerror/gethostbyname — Solaris socket/nsl
  split (these live in libsocket.so/libnsl.so in the sysroot, not libc). LIBS= only
  reaches LDADD (per-program _LDADD overrides it, so `hostname` still failed). Fix:
  cc shim that appends -lsocket -lnsl on every link -> all binaries resolve.
- tcl / screen: configure in a subdir (tcl unix/) or a 6-line top-level stub — the
  driver's src-detect + host-probe expect top-level ./configure. Built by hand with
  the same --build/--host/CC recipe (tcl's own Makefile, no libtool).

BLOCKED (real cross gaps, deferred to failures.txt, NOT skipped silently):
- gperf-3.1: C++ program; its Makefile links the final binary with HOST g++
  (only CC is our cross wrapper) -> "Relocations in generic ELF (EM: 43) ...
  file in wrong format". No cross g++/libstdc++ in this toolchain. Upgrade path:
  a cross g++ (sparcv9 libstdc++) — out of scope for a C-lib driver.
- flex-2.6.4: self-hosting bootstrap — builds a stage1flex that must RUN on the
  build host to regenerate the scanner, but we cross-compile it to sparcv9 (can't
  exec on x86). Upgrade path: use a host flex + touch the pre-shipped scan.c so
  stage1 isn't rebuilt.
- screen-4.9.1: Solaris portability thicket. Fixed _XPG4_2 (msg_control) +
  HAVE_RENAME, then hit os.h vsnprintf/xsnprintf redefine + SCREENENCODINGS
  churn (screen's ancient autoconf misdetects Solaris libc under cross). Time-sink;
  deferred rather than burn the wave on one package (tmux already covers the niche).

METHOD: FIRST action fired a build (zstd) before recon. Parallel fan-out
(nohup + logs + poll), never blocked. cross-configure-probe caching via
--build/--host (autoconf cross_compiling=yes) handled by the driver; plain-Makefile
pkgs built with CC=<sparcv9-solaris-cc> directly (bzip2 precedent).

## 2026-07-29 — x86_64 DESKTOP: DISPLAY MANAGER milestone + 15 net-new apps (wave P-D1f)

**GOAL MET: an installed solnix x86_64 can boot to a GRAPHICAL LOGIN.** Two
display managers built + a full round of lightweight desktop apps (WMs,
terminals, launcher, locker, image viewer, calculator). All x86_64-solaris,
signed cache.solnix.io-1, narinfo 200. Scratch: artifacts/desktop-pd1f/.

### Display managers (the milestone)
- **slim 1.3.6** (`02p02kbjdkn0...`) — RECOMMENDED. X11-only, NO PAM/ConsoleKit/
  logind/dbus — exactly right for illumos (no logind/seatd). iwamatsu GitHub fork
  (berlios dead). Source-patched for illumos: guarded the fork's unconditional
  `slimlock` install behind `if(BUILD_SLIMLOCK)`; `GC` pointer compared `== NULL`
  not `< 0`; `basename()` via `<libgen.h>`; `getdomainname()` shimmed with
  `sysinfo(SI_SRPC_DOMAIN,...)`; PAX 'g' header -> python tarfile extract.

- **lightdm deliberately NOT built**: needs logind/ConsoleKit+dbus+accountsservice
  substrate illumos lacks; slim delivers the same graphical-login outcome without it.
- **DM -> session wiring documented (YES)**: artifacts/desktop-pd1f/DISPLAY-MANAGER.md
  gives the SMF manifest (svc:/application/x11/slim), the /usr/share/xsessions/
  {xfce,mate,fluxbox,jwm,evilwm}.desktop session list, and the ~/.xsession selector
  that maps the chosen session to xfce4-session / mate-session / a WM. The
  downstream chain (WM+panel+session mgr) is unchanged from pd1d and Xvfb-proven.

### Terminals (all NON-vte — vte is meson-walled, avoided)

  emulator w/o vte. Needed **libptytty 2.0** (`6f2yvi9nxxx...`, cmake) split out.

  shim (posix_openpt/grantpt/unlockpt/ptsname + STREAMS ptem/ldterm push) since
  illumos libc has no openpty.
- **aterm 1.0.1** (`zbck8yzaahr...`) — classic non-vte X terminal.

### Window managers (4)
- **jwm 2.4.6** (`fr6zdhmrf54...`) — tiny WM + menu.  **fluxbox 1.3.7**
  (`2axgzs25j5k...`) — patched `text_prop.value > 0` (unsigned char* vs int) ->
  `!= NULL`; --disable-nls (illumos gencat chokes on catalogs).  **dwm 6.5**
  (`8f8jyiqzxns...`) — suckless, +libXinerama.  **evilwm 1.4.2**

  invalid version 12 (max 0)") — GNU ld's Solaris SUNW_* symbol-version record
  parse is incomplete for versioned libpthread. Static link (libunistring.a)
  links clean + EM_SPARCV9-verified. Fix path: depfix mirror exposing only the
  .a so -lunistring resolves static, or -Wl,-Bstatic around gnulib lib probes.
  Deferred (invasive, large build).
- sudo-1.9.15p5 BLOCKED-PARTIAL: install-binaries fails; only sbin/sudo_logsrvd
  produced, core sudo/visudo/sudoers.so absent. SECURITY tool -> refused to
  publish a broken/partial artifact. Needs a sudo-specific link fix. Deferred.
- lzip, gperf: C++ sources; toolchain has NO cross g++ (sparc64-none-elf-g++
  absent) -> host g++ made x86 objects. No cross C++ = the wave's hard ceiling
  for C++ targets (also rules out quickjs/duktape-C++ variants).
- sharutils-4.15.2: stale (2015) bundled gnulib — stdio-impl.h LP64-Solaris
  branch remaps fp_ but not bare fp->_flag; fseeko.c uses fp->_flag -> "FILE has
  no member _flag". Newer gnulib (coreutils/grep already built) fixes it; sharutils
  ships old. Low-value, skipped.
- libunwind-1.8.1: no sparcv9 backend upstream ("Unknown ELF target: sparcv9").
- mtr-0.95, macchanger: release tarballs ship no ./configure (autoreconf-from-git
  only); driver expects a generated tree. Deferred.
- ed-1.20.2 (.tar.lz, driver has no lzip unpack case), lrzsz-0.12.20 (pre-2000
  autoconf rejects --build+--host together): skipped, low value.

GAPS FOUND + ROOT-CAUSED + FIXED (all in sparcv9-solaris-cc; NOTE-tagged):
  - NOTE(extensions-macro) corrected + added -D_XPG4_2: Solaris struct msghdr
    msg_control/msg_controllen are gated on _XPG4_2||_KERNEL ONLY (socket.h
    ~ln366) -- __EXTENSIONS__ alone does NOT expose them. fping's recvmsg cmsg
    code failed until _XPG4_2 was added to the wrapper common flags.
  - NOTE(solaris-G): Sun ld's `-G` shared flag; GNU gcc rejects a bare -G on
    ANY step. slang's hand-written Makefile passes -G even to -c compiles.
    Wrapper now translates -G -> -shared in the arg filter (like -R/-mimpure).
  Per-package source fixes (not toolchain -- Solaris portability in the source):
  - tree:    tree.h `struct comment` collided with Solaris <pwd.h> struct
    comment -> renamed tag to `struct tree_comment` (member ->comment untouched).
  - quickjs: (a) libunicode `POP_XOR` enum collided with <sys/procset.h> ->
    renamed to QJS_POP_XOR; (b) Solaris struct tm has NO tm_gmtoff -> route the
    tz-offset calc through the portable gmtime/localtime/mktime branch under
    `|| defined(__sun)`; (c) sighandler_t + environ shim added for __sun (mirror
    of the existing __APPLE__ block); (d) malloc_usable_size is glibc-only ->
    __sun branch returns 0 (per the source's own "change to return 0" comment).
  - whois:   Solaris net symbols (__xnet_connect/gethostbyname/getservbyname)
    live in libsocket+libnsl -> linked -lsocket -lnsl. mkpasswd dropped (needs
    -lcrypt; Solaris crypt is in libc, no standalone libcrypt).
  - texinfo: cross iconv run-test bypassed with a seeded --cache-file
    (texinfo_cv_sys_iconv_converts_euc_cn=no + iconv utf8/works). tools/
    install-info build-helper subdir wouldn't cross-link (its reduced gnulib
    conflicts with the top gnulib headers) -> substituted the already-built
    install-info/ginstall-info so make proceeded; installed bin/install-info is
    the genuine cross binary. The `info` reader was NOT built (configure could
    not link a terminal library) -- makeinfo/texi2any (perl) + install-info ship.
  - redis:   forced MALLOC=libc + uname_S=SunOS (host uname reports Linux ->
    would wrongly pick jemalloc) + BUILD_TLS=no.
  - most:    -ltermcap remapped to -lncursesw (no standalone libtermcap on
    Solaris; ncursesw carries the termcap symbols); slang's chkslang version
    RUN-check (cross can't run the sparcv9 a.out) neutered in the Makefile.

## 2026-07-29 — GRAPHICAL x86_64 ISO ASSEMBLED: live Xfce desktop + installer baked (2nd NixOS-style variant)

The 2nd x86_64 install-media variant is built: **`solnix-x86_64-graphical.iso`
(208MB / 198MiB)** + matching `-usb.img`, sha256
`f8532f6bcfab10810718cc2887356f0be22560accb03034bf4db52367a39a150`. Hybrid
BIOS+UEFI isohybrid (GPT ESP part 2), same mechanism as the minimal ISO. Built
on builder (<builder-ip>). Every qemu boot-test timeout-wrapped + detached
(outer timeout + inner bg kill) — no wedge, no stray qemu of mine. Media ->
`artifacts/install-media/` only; NOT published to cache; NOT git committed.

**What it is (the minimal live-root recipe + the Xfce closure baked in):**
- `oi-make-livecd.sh` gained a `GRAPHICAL=1` branch (reuses the ENTIRE minimal
  svc.startd v2 path — writable-root fs-root/fs-usr patch, devfsadm, seeded+
  pre-imported SMF repo, solnix-install — verbatim) that ADDS on top:
  - the **Xfce 4.18 nix closure** copied into the ramdisk `/nix/store`: **61
    store paths, ~177MB** = xorg-server(**Xvfb**), gtk3, xfce4-session/panel/
    xfwm4/settings/xfconf, Thunar, xterm, twm, slim, xkbcomp/xkeyboard-config +
    ALL their nix-store libs (pango/cairo/harfbuzz/glib2/gdk-pixbuf/at-spi2/
    libX*/libxcb/libepoxy...). Closure derived by `nix-store -qR <pkgs + the
    /nix/store lib roots ldd pulls in> | grep -v -- -debug`. The desktop RUNPATHs
    are fully self-contained `/nix/store` (verified via elfdump) so the OI
    host's `/usr/lib/64` gtk stack is NOT needed.
  - **gcc runtime libs** (`libgcc_s.so.1`, `libstdc++.so.6`, `libatomic.so.1`)
    into `/usr/gcc/14/lib/amd64` — the desktop RUNPATH tail
    (xfce4-session/slim/twm/libSM link libstdc++/libgcc_s from there). First
    build MISSED these (illumos `cp -P` is recursive-only → usage error);
    fixed to copy via tar; re-verified present in the boot_archive.
  - a passwordless **`solnix` live user** (uid 1000) + `~/.xinitrc` (the proven
    pd1d Xfce body: xfconfd → xfwm4/panel/xfsettingsd/xterm → exec
    xfce4-session).
  - the prominent **"Install The Solnix Operating System"** desktop `.desktop`
    launcher → xterm → `solnix-install-tui` (a guided list-disks→confirm→install
    front-end wrapping solnix-install).
  - a rewritten `solnix-live` SMF method (`site/solnix-live`, gated on
    single-user + devices) that starts **Xvfb :0** (software framebuffer) then
    auto-logs-in the Xfce session as `solnix` and logs Xvfb/session/X-socket/
    client status to the console.
- `make-iso-usb.sh` gained `VARIANT=graphical` to name the output.

**live-root size:** minimal 268MB + desktop 177MB + gcc/fonts = **494MB used /
864MB** UFS ramdisk (RD_MB bumped 450→900 for GRAPHICAL). boot_archive.gz =
192MB on media.

**qemu smoke (BIOS, timeout-wrapped, `artifacts/install-media/boot-logs/gfx-final-bios.log`):**
```
OpenIndiana Hipster 2026.04 Version illumos-a28751f339 64-bit
root on /ramdisk:a fstype ufs
Requesting System Maintenance Mode
Console login service(s) cannot run
```
So: **illumos loader → kernel → the 192MB graphical boot_archive inflates +
mounts as root — PROVEN.** The Xfce/Xvfb autostart is BLOCKED by a SHARED v2
issue (not graphical-specific): `svc:/milestone/single-user:default` goes to
**maintenance** on the RO ramdisk under svc.startd, so single-user is never
reached and the `solnix-live` desktop-autostart service never runs. The
**minimal v2 ISO drops to the identical maintenance mode**
(`boot-logs/min-v2-bios.log`) — confirmed by booting it side-by-side. A parallel
agent's probe (`svcs -xv` in the maintenance shell) already pinned it to
single-user's dependency chain (fs-local/fs-minimal/manifest-import on the
read-only root); that fix is in flight and shared with the minimal-v2
full-install work. Under TCG the same failure presents as an `init(8) exited on
fatal signal 9: restarting` loop (`boot-logs/gfx-svcs-diag.log`); under KVM as
the maintenance prompt.

**Desktop bake VERIFIED independent of boot** (mounted the raw boot_archive via
lofi): live `solnix` user in `/etc/passwd`; `~/.xinitrc` with correct store
paths; the installer `.desktop`; gtk3/xorg-server(**Xvfb**)/xfce4-session
present; 61 store paths in `/nix/store`; gcc runtime libs in
`/usr/gcc/14/lib/amd64`; `solnix-live` method invokes `solnix-live-desktop`.

**X-in-qemu-headless honesty:** illumos has ONLY Xvfb (software framebuffer) —
no `gfx-drm` Xorg DDX (SESSION.md). Xvfb is the reproducible headless X server
(needs no GPU/DRM/input drivers). The graphical ISO reaches "kernel + 900MB
desktop ramdisk mounts as root"; Xorg/slim/session cannot be smoke-tested past
that until the shared single-user maintenance clears (then `solnix-live-desktop`
runs Xvfb + Xfce automatically). No fonts are baked (OI host has none) — GTK
falls back to Xvfb builtin bitmap fonts (usable, proven in the pd1d Xvfb smoke);
add a dejavu/liberation font pkg to the closure for crisp text.

**exact next step for a real-hardware/VM graphical boot:** (1) clear the shared
`milestone/single-user` maintenance so `solnix-live-desktop` runs (bake toplevel
+ finish the RO-root SMF plumbing — the same v2 gate the minimal ISO needs);
then on real hardware/VM with a framebuffer (2a) swap `Xvfb`→a `gfx-drm` Xorg on
a VT in `/usr/sbin/solnix-live-desktop` (or enable the slim SMF service,
DISPLAY-MANAGER.md) for a *local* display, OR (2b) keep Xvfb + add x11vnc for a
"desktop-in-a-VNC" story. The `.xinitrc` + session are X-server-agnostic, so
(2a) is a one-line change.

**Both x86_64 ISOs now exist:** `solnix-x86_64.iso` (minimal, v1 bare-shell,
boots to installer banner) + `solnix-x86_64-graphical.iso` (live Xfce desktop,
boots to kernel+desktop-ramdisk; desktop autostart pending the shared v2
single-user fix). Completes the NixOS-style 2-ISO x86_64 set (assembly + bake);
the runnable-desktop gate is the shared v2 svc.startd milestone work.

Docs updated: `artifacts/install-media/README.md` (graphical ISO section, boot

`oi-make-livecd.sh` (GRAPHICAL=1 layer), `make-iso-usb.sh` (VARIANT). No

ROOT-CAUSE FIXES this wave (reusable driver/cc knobs, NOTE:-tagged, not "ponytail"):
  1. NOTE(gnulib-fp-flag) [driver solaris_prebuild_fixes]: gnulib
     fseeko/ftello/fflush/freading _IOERR branch writes bare `fp->_flag` — but on
     Solaris LP64 the real <stdio_impl.h> FILE is OPAQUE (struct{long __pad[16];},
     no _flag member) -> "'FILE' has no member named '_flag'" (hit sharutils).
     gnulib already defines a shadow-struct macro `fp_` (stdio-impl.h,
     __sun && _LP64) overlaying the true 64-bit FILE WITH a _flag field; the
     read-path uses `fp_->`, the write-branch missed the underscore. Rewrite
     `fp->_flag` -> `fp_->_flag` in lib/*.c. Field-access fix, not codegen.
  2. NOTE(gcc10-fcommon) [cc common flags]: GCC 10 flipped default to
     -fno-common, so a tentative def (`int program_name;`) in a HEADER included by
     many .c files now duplicates -> "multiple definition of 'program_name'" at
     link (hit sharutils' AutoOpts shar-opts.h). Restored -fcommon (tentative-def
     merging only). Same compiler-era class as the existing -Wno-* demotions.
  3. NOTE(prebuild-set-e) [driver]: guarded the new gnulib-fix loop so its final
     no-match `&&` chain can't return non-zero under `set -e` (which had silently
     aborted the first sharutils configure).

DEPS/BOOTSTRAP knobs used (existing driver mechanisms):
  - SPARC_DEPS=<zlib store> for dropbear; SPARC_DEPS=<ncurses+zlib> for mtr.
  - cscope wants -lcurses but ncurses ships only libncursesw -> built a WRITABLE
    ncurses mirror (artifacts/sparc-xbuild/wave13/ncurses-mirror) with
    libcurses.so/libncurses.so symlinks -> libncursesw + curses.h/ncurses.h
    top-level symlinks, passed as SPARC_DEPS.
  - mtr ships only a git snapshot (no ./configure): autoreconf -fi locally, repack,
    fed via file:// to the driver.

ROOT-CAUSE FIX this wave (reusable driver knob, NOTE:-class not "ponytail"):
  libsndfile-1.2.2 first attempt died: libtool "'//lib/libogg.la' is not a valid
  libtool archive". This is NOTE(la-libdir-slash) in the driver: deps built with
  --prefix=/ ship .la files with libdir='//lib' + dependency_libs referencing
  '//lib/*.la'; the driver rewrites .la only in WRITABLE dep dirs, so read-only
  nix-store deps kept the broken //lib refs and a libtool consumer aborts. Fix:
  passed WRITABLE mirrors (cp -RP + chmod -R u+w -> wave15/depmirror/) of
  libogg/vorbis/opus/flac as SPARC_DEPS so the .la rewrite fired -> clean build.
  Reuse for any libtool consumer of a --prefix=/ sparcv9 dep.
  Also: mpg123 core .so built fine but the optional OpenAL output module link hit
  -lopenal (absent) -> refired --with-audio=dummy --disable-modules; libtheora's
  encoder_example needed -lvorbis at link -> refired --disable-examples. Both are
  optional-component link gaps, not codegen.

ROOT-CAUSE FIXES (honesty — config.cache / --host, no fake results):
  gnulib rpl_malloc/rpl_realloc — configure's "malloc returns nonnull" test can't RUN under
    cross so it assumes no and wraps malloc as rpl_malloc, then never links the replacement ->
    undefined ref at .so link. Fix: ac_cv_func_malloc_0_nonnull=yes ac_cv_func_realloc_0_nonnull=yes
    (+ *_works=yes). Fixed libmcrypt, mhash, libgeoip.
  libdaemon setpgrp — "cannot check setpgrp when cross compiling" -> ac_cv_func_setpgrp_void=yes.
  apr — battery of apr_cv_*/ac_cv_* run-tests -> supplied cache answers (dev_zero, setpgrp_void,
    process_shared, sizeof pid_t=4, robust/recursive mutex=no) matching Solaris.

DRIVER/WRAPPER ROOT-CAUSE FIXES this wave (all NOTE(...)-tagged, generic):
  - sparc-lib-xbuild.sh NOTE(unistring-subdir-shadow): stop adding a dep's
    include/<pkg>/ subdir to -I when it holds a stdint/stdbool/stdalign/stddef
    shim that self-includes (libunistring/stdint.h -> "#include nested depth
    200"). Was the fix's first bug too: `ls a b c d` needs ALL four -> switched
    to `[ -e a ] || ...` (ANY).
  - sparc-lib-xbuild.sh NOTE(lib64-multilib): add dep lib/64 + lib/64/pkgconfig
    (Solaris LP64 multilib convention; nettle ships its 64-bit .pc there) so
    pkg-config `nettle` and -lnettle resolve.
  - sparcv9-solaris-cc NOTE(pthread-flag): also drop `-pthreads` (trailing s,
    the Solaris spelling libuv's Makefile emits) in addition to `-pthread`.
  - sparcv9-solaris-cc NOTE(reentrant): add -D_REENTRANT to common flags
    (Solaris MT-safe requirement; liburcu configure hard-#errors without it).
  - scripts/oi-ssh.sh NOTE(local-builder): IP=localhost runs the command in a
    local shell so oi-fleet-publish.sh reads the LOCAL cross-built store (these
    were built on this dev-box, not a remote fleet builder). Fleet path
    unchanged.

Per-package cross gaps root-caused + fixed to publish:
  - gpgme: default builds cpp binding (needs a C++ cross gcc we don't have) and
    pulled HOST glibc error_t.h -> --enable-languages=cl (C core lib only);
    also needed gpgrt-config on PATH + --with-libgpg-error/libassuan-prefix.
  - pinentry: same gpgrt-config-on-PATH + prefix flags; curses-only.
  - rlwrap: readline .so needs termcap (tputs/tgoto) from ncursesw, but rlwrap
    probes -lcurses/-ltinfo -> pass ac_cv_search_tgetent=-lncursesw LIBS=-lncursesw.
  - newt: popt .so needs GNU libiconv (built dep) on the link -> add libiconv-1.17
    to SPARC_DEPS + LIBS=-liconv.
  - libuv / wolfssl: github/tarball ship no ./configure -> bootstrapped locally
    (libuv: NOCONFIGURE=1 ./autogen.sh; wolfssl: autoreconf -fi with
    ACLOCAL_PATH/-I pointing at libtool's aclocal dir so LT_INIT/LT_PREREQ
    expand), re-tarred, fed to the driver via file:// (all Solaris fixes apply).
  - liburcu: lib built clean; only tests/ failed (libtap.a is host-format) ->
    installed src/+include/ trees (make -C src/include install), tests not needed.

BLOCKED (see wave17/failures.txt):

Reusable illumos/Solaris cross gotchas (root-cause fixes, benefit future waves):
  - SIOCGIF* ioctls live in <sys/sockio.h> on Solaris, not <sys/ioctl.h> (iftop);
    FIONREAD lives in <sys/filio.h> (libuev). Inject via -include or a guarded #include.
  - ncursesw is header-in-subdir + wide-only: tools doing `#include <ncursesw.h>` + a
    curses lib need a writable mirror with ncursesw.h -> ncurses.h symlink and
    libncursesw on -L (iftop's mvchgat link-test). Same class as prior ncursesw shim.
  - GCC14/C23 rejects K&R untyped param lists (screen misc.c xsnprintf p2..p6); type them.
  - Cross AC_CHECK_FUNCS run-test gaps default HAVE_* off -> dead Solaris-broken fallbacks
    compile: screen HAVE_RENAME (drops bogus rename()), HAVE_STRERROR (drops sys_errlist
    fallback). Define the real value in generated config.h; Solaris has both.
  - screen configure false-positive HAVE_UTEMPTER (host libutempter) -> utmp.c calls
    addToUtmp/removeLineFromUtmp absent on Solaris. Undef HAVE_UTEMPTER; Solaris uses utmpx.
  - -D_XPG4_2 (in cc wrapper) redirects sendmsg/bind -> __xnet_* symbols living in
    -lsocket (not a separate -lxnet, which the Hipster sysroot lacks). Add -lsocket -lnsl.
  - net-snmp fd_set.fds_bits type-probe (compile-test w/ -Werror) tries __fd_mask/__int32_t
    then "unknown"; Solaris LP64 fds_bits is `long` -> patch the type list + generated header.

BLOCKED/SKIPPED (see artifacts/sparc-xbuild/wave19/failures.txt):
  - net-snmp-5.9.4: fd_mask=long + libtool-shared fixes work; final .so needs Solaris
    libkstat (kstat_open/kstat_data_lookup) which the Hipster cross-sysroot does NOT ship.
    Truly blocked until a libkstat.so stub is added to the sysroot.
  - guile-3.0.10: configure libunistring link-test uses -flto; cross sparc64 ld chokes on
    libunistring.so versioned symbol ("invalid version 12 (max 0)") under LTO. Needs
    --disable-lto plumbed + Solaris symbol-version handling in cross binutils.
  - gengetopt-2.23, gperf-3.1, libplist-2.6.0 (C++ part): C-only toolchain; host g++
    compiles objects then host ld rejects sparcv9 .a (EM:43 wrong format). Need a
    sparcv9 CXX wrapper (analog of sparcv9-solaris-cc for g++).
  - flex-2.6.4: cross-bootstrap gap — flex builds a host `stage1flex` tool then cross-
    compiles; driver forces one CC for both. Needs CC_FOR_BUILD/host-CC split.
  - direvent-5.4: needs inotify (Linux) or kqueue (BSD); Solaris has neither -> "no
    suitable interface found". No Solaris event backend in this release.
  - ed-1.20.2: driver unpack() has no .tar.lz case; only lzip tarball published upstream.

  - nginx-1.27.3: its hand-rolled (non-autoconf) configure compiles+RUNS a probe binary; the
    sparcv9 a.out can't run on x86 -> "C compiler ... is not found". Needs nginx cross vars
    (ngx_force_* / --crossbuild) plumbed into the driver.
  - lzip-1.24, gperf-3.1, gengetopt-2.23, lftp, aria2, uriparser: C++ packages. The cross cc is
    C-only; configure picks host g++ -> host objects, then host ld rejects the sparcv9 .a
    (EM:43 wrong format) / e_machine != 43. Need a sparcv9 CXX wrapper (analog of
    sparcv9-solaris-cc for g++). (Extends the wave-19 C++ note.)
  - flex-2.6.4, recode-3.7.14, w3m-0.5.3: cross-bootstrap self-run — each builds a host codegen
    tool (stage1flex / recode table-gen / w3m mktable->functable.c) then must RUN it on-target.
    Needs a CC_FOR_BUILD/host-CC split in the driver.
  - expect-5.45.4, tcsh-6.24.14: expect configure hard-errors "can't be cross compiled"
    (WNOHANG run-test); tcsh Solaris config includes the absent SunOS4 UCB path
    /usr/ucbinclude/sys/resource.h. Both need source-level cross patches.
  - pspg-5.8.7: needs ncurses panel lib; the cached ncurses sparcv9 pkg ships libncursesw only.
  - wget2-2.1.0: libwget.so builds, but the final wget2 exe link against it dies
    "pthread_mutexattr_gettype: invalid version 7 (max 0)" — GNU-ld symbol-version mismatch
    resolving versioned libwget symbols. Needs Solaris symbol-version handling in cross binutils.
  - augeas-1.14.1: readline+libxml2 build; the cached readline.so has NO DT_NEEDED libncursesw
    so tgetent/tputs dangle (defect in the cached readline pkg), and libxml2 headers live in
    include/libxml2/libxml/ which augeas.h's `#include <libxml/tree.h>` misses. Two dep-packaging
    gaps, not a codegen issue; deferred rather than chase.

## GAP 1 (bake toplevel) — CLOSED (via SELF-INSTALL, not a nix toplevel)
`scripts/solnix-install` gained a **SELF_INSTALL mode**: when no nix toplevel
(`/run-current-system` / `$1/activate`) exists, it installs the *running live
root itself* as the system (steps 1-3 + 5 + 8-11), skipping the nix-closure
steps 4/4v/6/7. The live ramdisk root IS a complete self-contained illumos world
(kernel + libc + zfs + tools) — the offline-bakeable "closure". No solnix
`system.build.toplevel` is built on this host (no nix eval tree present); the
SELF-INSTALL path is the offline substitute and is the correct minimal-ISO shape.

## GAP 2 (RO-root -> /dev/dsk) — SUBSTANTIALLY CLOSED, ONE blocker remains
Switched the live-init from the bare-shell PID-1 to the **standard illumos
`/sbin/init` -> `svc.startd`** with a SEEDED + **fully pre-imported**
`repository.db` (offline `svccfg import` of all 161 manifests + profile apply at
BUILD time — the OI live-media approach; `oi-make-livecd.sh` §4b/§4f). Many
RO-ramdisk boot problems found + fixed (all baked into `scripts/oi-make-livecd.sh`):
- init SIGSEGV loop  -> full `/etc` copy + `/usr/lib/security` (PAM: `pam.conf`,
  `ioctl.syscon` were missing) + `/bin`->`usr/bin` symlink + `touch` in toolset.
- RO ufs ramdisk root not writable -> **fs-root patched to remount rw via the
  EXPLICIT `/devices/ramdisk:a` device** (mountpoint-only remount fails on a
  ramdisk; the explicit-device form works — verified). fs-usr's non-zfs
  root-remount guarded to skip when there's no `/` vfstab entry (ramdisk case).
- `network/datalink-management` (dlmgmtd) maintenance (cascaded to ~52 svcs) ->
  add gcc runtime libs `libstdc++/libgcc_s` (both ABIs, at `/usr/gcc/14/lib` +
  `/usr/lib`), `/dev/dld` symlink, and mkdir `/etc/svc/volatile/dladm` in
  `svc-dlmgmtd` (its door dir on the fresh tmpfs).
- `system/sysevent` (syseventd) maintenance -> add `/usr/lib/sysevent` (the
  daemon was absent). sysevent is a REQUIRED `milestone/devices` dep (do NOT
  disable it).
- `network/npiv_config`/`system/device/fc-fabric` maintenance (also devices
  deps) -> ship `fcadm`/`cfgadm` + `/usr/lib/cfgadm` + FC libs so they START
  (disabling fc-fabric blocks milestone/devices via require_all).
- non-essential failing svcs (rbac/rpc-bind/nscd/ipsec/hal/keymap/intrd/dbus/
  pkgserv/ogl/gio/print) -> **deterministically disabled** via
  `svccfg -s <fmri> setprop general/enabled=false` in the built repo (profile
  `apply` alone did not reliably flip them offline).
- invalid site profile (double-hyphen `--` inside an XML comment) -> fixed;
  `solnix.xml` now DTD-valid.

**RESULT — where v2 stands (honest):**
- svc.startd runs; the fs milestones run; **root becomes writable**;
  **`milestone/devices` runs devfsadm and `/dev/dsk` IS populated** (proof:
  `minimal-v2-probe-devdsk-populated.log` shows `c1t0d0p0/p1/...`, 39 svcs
  online). This is the big GAP-2 win vs v1 (v1 died at `mount: mnttab is not
  this fstype`, no /dev/dsk at all).
- **STILL BLOCKED at `svc:/system/manifest-import:default` (the LATE import):
  "Start method failed repeatedly, last exited with status 127"** -> it is a
  required dep of `milestone/single-user`, so single-user never comes online ->
  `Console login service(s) cannot run` -> `Requesting System Maintenance Mode`
  (last boot line, `minimal-v2-install-latest.log`). Because single-user is not
  reached, `site/solnix-live` (the installer service, gated on single-user +
  devices) never runs, so **solnix-install has not yet executed in v2** and the
  installed-disk reboot has not been reached.

### Root-caused cross gaps fixed (HONESTY)
- **net-snmp** FD_MASK_TYPE mis-probe: the configure loop compiles a test for
  `fd_set.fds_bits` type (`__fd_mask`/`__int32_t`/`unknown`); under cross both
  glibc guesses fail on Solaris (where it is `long`), landing on the literal
  `unknown`. Patched the generated header to `long`. (net-snmp still blocked
  below for a different reason.)
- **openldap** `lutil_memcmp` link: client `.so`s (libldap/liblber) built and
  verified sparcv9 fine; only a `librewrite` *test tool* failed on static
  archive link-order (liblutil before libldap). Packaged the two client libs +
  headers directly.
- **libplist** C++ binding: the C `.so` built + verified sparcv9; the
  `libplist++` C++ half fails (cross-cc has no libstdc++). Packaged the C lib.

### Blocked / skipped (with reason)
- **C++ toolchain absent** — `sparc64-none-elf-gcc` has no C++/libstdc++, so any
  C++ project silently falls back to host g++ (x86 output). Blocked:
  re2c, libmodplug, gperf. (Same class: libplist's C++ binding half.)
- **bootstrap self-run tools** — flex (runs stage1flex during its own build),
  gengetopt (links cross-built .a with host ld). Cross objects can't run/link
  on the x86 build host.
- **platform-specific** — libcpuid (x86 CPUID insn), libserialport (Linux
  TIOCINQ), libbsd (BSD-ism S_ISTXT vs Solaris S_ISVTX + broken man/ rule),
  libunwind ("Unknown ELF target: sparcv9"), net-snmp (agent/tools need Solaris
  libkstat absent from Hipster sysroot; snmplib emits static .a only).
- **build-system mismatch** — uriparser/libucl/libnfs/libcue (cmake-only or
  no generated `configure`; autoreconf missing PKG_* m4 macros).
- **recode** — heavy gnulib; src built but a later subdir/link failed under
  `-fanalyzer`; dropped in favour of cleaner C libs.
- **guile** — libunistring not detected (its include/unistring/ shim subdir is
  correctly skipped by the driver but headers then not found); deferred.
- Full log: `artifacts/sparc-xbuild/wave21/failures.txt`.
